sheets.subject: noor (top-left reference portrait)
sheets.prompt: Create an original transparent dialogue expression atlas for Noor, the violet-haired woman in the TOP LEFT cell of the supplied Poem portrait sheet. Use that one cell for character identity and painting style only. Ignore all other characters. Preserve medium dark brown skin, amber eyes, flowing dark violet waves, gold celestial hair chains, moon and star earrings with blue gem drops, embroidered midnight-blue mantle patterned with gold constellations, white underlayer and a gold astrolabe clasp, together with the same three-quarter view facing viewer’s right. Output a wide canvas with exactly three equal square cells in one horizontal row. Each cell contains a complete isolated chest-up portrait with matching scale, silhouette, costume, hairstyle, body pose, head position and torso crop. Place the entire figure inside each cell with a generous truly transparent gutter on all four sides, including space below the aligned straight bottom crop. Change facial expression only: LEFT clear intellectual resolve with steady brows and a firm mouth, CENTER alarmed thoughtfulness with raised inner brows and barely parted lips, RIGHT small knowing warmth with a restrained closed-mouth smile. Match the clean illustrated fantasy linework and painted color of the source. The figure is opaque and every pixel outside the silhouette is truly transparent. No added props, text, labels, frames, backdrop, halo, or outside shadows. This is original artwork for Poem. The three portraits must swap smoothly in a conversation.
sheets.notes: Original source pixels and alpha are preserved. Measured transparent gutters separate the three 724×724 atlas regions.
